title: Product Sourcing from China
short: Tell us what you need and we find, compare and negotiate with the right factories.
intro: We turn your product idea, sample or reference link into a shortlist of real manufacturers. Our China team contacts suppliers, compares quotes, negotiates price and MOQ, and reports back to you in plain English.
points: Supplier shortlist with side by side quote comparison
Price and MOQ negotiation with factories
Sourcing across Yiwu, Shenzhen, Guangzhou and Shanghai
Clear written updates at every step
Quote response target of one hour

faq.q: How do I start sourcing a product with Global Grabz?
faq.a: Send us a product description, photos or a link through the quote form or WhatsApp. We reply with next steps and a first supplier shortlist.

faq.q: Do you source for buyers outside Pakistan?
faq.a: Yes. We work with buyers in the USA, Europe, Australia, Asia and the Middle East.

title: Supplier Verification and Factory Audit
short: Check that a supplier is a real, capable factory before you pay a deposit.
intro: Many sourcing problems start with the wrong supplier. We verify business licences, confirm whether the supplier is a factory or a trading company, and visit the site when needed so you can decide with facts.
points: On site visit with photos and video
Production capacity and lead time review

faq.q: Can you visit a factory for me?
faq.a: Yes. Our China team can visit the factory, record video, check equipment and report what they see before you place an order.

faq.q: Why verify a supplier before paying?
faq.a: Verification reduces the risk of fake suppliers, unrealistic lead times and surprise quality problems.

title: Quality Inspection and AQL Checks
short: Pre-production, in-production and pre-shipment checks before goods leave China.
intro: We inspect your goods against your specification and an agreed AQL level, then send photos, measurements and a clear pass or fail result before the balance payment is made.
points: Pre-shipment random inspection based on AQL
Photo and video report within the agreed timeline

faq.a: AQL is a sampling standard that defines how many units are checked from a batch and how many defects are acceptable.
The most common point is pre-shipment, when production is finished and before the final payment is released.

title: Sample Management and Try Before You Buy
short: Test product quality with samples before you commit to a bulk order.
intro: We request, collect and consolidate samples from several suppliers, check them in China and ship them to you. Free product samples are available on selected items, so you can judge quality before ordering in bulk.
points: Consolidated sample shipping by air courier
Free samples available on selected products

faq.a: Free samples depend on the product and supplier. Contact us and we will confirm the sample terms for your item.

faq.q: How long do samples take to arrive?
faq.a: Delivery time depends on your country and the courier selected. We share a tracking number as soon as samples are dispatched.

title: Private Label and OEM Manufacturing
short: Put your brand on a product, from logo to custom packaging.
intro: Whether you need your logo on an existing product or a fully custom design, we find factories that accept OEM and private label orders, manage artwork and approvals, and keep production on schedule.
points: Factories with OEM and ODM experience

faq.q: What is the difference between OEM and private label?
faq.a: OEM means a factory makes a product to your design. Private label means you brand a product the factory already makes.

faq.q: Can I order a small quantity?
faq.a: Minimum order quantities vary by factory. We negotiate lower MOQs where possible and tell you honestly when a factory will not agree.

title: International Shipping and Logistics
short: Air freight, sea freight and overland shipping from China to your door.
intro: We arrange freight from China to the USA, Europe, Australia, Asia and the Middle East by air, sea or overland routes, prepare shipping documents and give you tracking at each key point.
points: Air freight for urgent and high value cargo
Sea freight FCL and LCL for bulk orders
Overland and border crossing routes where suitable
Shipment tracking from origin to destination

faq.q: Which shipping method should I choose?
faq.a: Air is faster and costs more per kilogram. Sea is slower and cheaper for heavy or bulky goods. We recommend one based on your budget and deadline.
Yes. Use the Track Shipment page with your tracking ID to see mode, current location, destination and status.

title: Warehousing and Cargo Consolidation
short: Combine goods from many suppliers into one shipment and save on freight.
intro: Suppliers deliver to our partner warehouse in China. We receive, check and store your goods, then consolidate them into a single shipment so you pay less freight and handle one set of paperwork.
points: Goods receiving and carton count check
Consolidation of multiple suppliers into one shipment
One shipment, one invoice, one tracking ID

faq.a: Consolidation lowers freight cost per unit and avoids paying several minimum charges for small supplier shipments.

faq.q: How long can you store goods?
faq.a: Storage terms depend on volume and duration. Tell us your plan and we will confirm the terms.

title: Amazon FBA Prep and Dropshipping Fulfilment
short: Prep, label and ship inventory for Amazon FBA or send single orders to your customers.
intro: Online sellers can use us to prepare stock for Amazon FBA, take product photos, and fulfil single orders for dropshipping. We handle labeling, bagging and carton rules so your stock is accepted at the fulfilment centre.

faq.q: Do you ship directly to Amazon FBA warehouses?
faq.a: Yes, we can prepare goods and ship them directly to the Amazon fulfilment center you choose.
Yes. We can pick, pack and ship single orders to your customers from China.
